title: Packages Manifest
description: Declares software dependencies for a writ project. Writ delegates to lore for installation.

packages.description: List of packages to install via lore

items.description: Package entry with name and optional features

name.description: Package name, in any of three forms: the canonical purl the pkg provider emits and reads (pkg:{type}/{namespace}/{name}@{version}?{qualifiers}), a manager-prefixed name (brew:jq), or a bare name resolved by the platform's default manager (jq). The purl form is the only one that can express a namespace (a winget publisher, an npm scope) or a qualifier (scope=machine).

with.description: Features to enable for this package
